# Mutable Storage Trait Hierarchy Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Complete the mutable half of the storage hierarchy in `src/storage/mod.rs`, including `RawStorageMut`, `StorageMut`, `StorageOwned`, `StorageShared`, `StorageIntoOwned`, and `StorageIntoRaw`.

**Architecture:** Mutability is layered explicitly: raw mutable pointer access, safe mutable element access, owned-storage construction operations, shared read-only queries, and conversion traits. Shared writable storage remains forbidden.

**Tech Stack:** Rust 1.85+, edition 2024, `core::ptr::NonNull`, `alloc::vec::Vec`, `crate::error::XenonError`

**Design Docs:** `design/05-storage.md` §5.4, §5.6, §5.7, §5.8, §5.9, §5.10, `design/00-coding.md` §6.2, §6.3

**Prerequisites:** W7T2 must be complete.

### Task 1: Add the complete mutable and conversion trait hierarchy

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/storage/mod.rs`

- [ ] **Step 1: Append the full trait hierarchy**

Append the following to `src/storage/mod.rs`:

```rust
use alloc::vec::Vec;
use core::ptr::NonNull;

use crate::error::XenonError;
use crate::storage::owned::Owned;

pub unsafe trait RawStorageMut: RawStorage {
    fn as_mut_ptr(&mut self) -> *mut Self::Elem;

    #[inline]
    unsafe fn as_non_null(&mut self) -> NonNull<Self::Elem> {
        if self.len() == 0 {
            NonNull::dangling()
        } else {
            NonNull::new_unchecked(self.as_mut_ptr())
        }
    }
}

pub unsafe trait StorageMut: Storage + RawStorageMut {
    #[inline]
    fn get_mut(&mut self, index: usize) -> Option<&mut Self::Elem> {
        if index < self.len() {
            Some(unsafe { &mut *self.as_mut_ptr().add(index) })
        } else {
            None
        }
    }

    #[inline]
    unsafe fn get_unchecked_mut(&mut self, index: usize) -> &mut Self::Elem {
        &mut *self.as_mut_ptr().add(index)
    }

    #[inline]
    fn as_mut_slice(&mut self) -> &mut [Self::Elem] {
        unsafe { core::slice::from_raw_parts_mut(self.as_mut_ptr(), self.len()) }
    }

    #[inline]
    fn fill(&mut self, value: Self::Elem)
    where
        Self::Elem: Copy,
    {
        self.as_mut_slice().fill(value);
    }
}

pub unsafe trait StorageOwned: StorageMut + Clone {
    fn zeros(len: usize) -> Self
    where
        Self::Elem: Default;

    fn from_elem(len: usize, value: Self::Elem) -> Self
    where
        Self::Elem: Clone;

    fn from_vec(vec: Vec<Self::Elem>) -> Result<Self, XenonError>
    where
        Self::Elem: Copy;

    fn from_iter<I: IntoIterator<Item = Self::Elem>>(iter: I) -> Self;
    fn into_vec(self) -> Vec<Self::Elem>;
    fn to_owned(&self) -> Self;
    fn capacity(&self) -> usize;
    fn try_reserve(&mut self, new_capacity: usize) -> Result<(), XenonError>;
}

pub unsafe trait StorageShared: Storage + Clone {
    fn is_unique(&self) -> bool;
    fn ref_count(&self) -> usize;
}

pub unsafe trait StorageIntoOwned: Storage {
    fn into_owned_storage(self) -> Owned<Self::Elem>
    where
        Self::Elem: Clone;
}

pub unsafe trait StorageIntoRaw: StorageOwned {
    unsafe fn into_raw(self) -> *mut Self::Elem;
}
```
